cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The map didn't find a door. Our real mission is waking this wall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So the map failed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At doors. Knock here; the wall looks asleep.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's not responding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we're meant to listen through it. Put your ear down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The treasure map ends at this solid wall. It secretly led us here to wake it. I'm knocking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nothing. And our torch is nearly out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we were sent to hear it in darkness. I'm putting the torch out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can only hear you breathing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's it. The map was testing our breath control. I'm holding mine.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 replaces finding a door with waking a wall; A5 replaces waking with listening, but B2 prompts no new mission.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2 with 'At doors' but repeats A1's mission; B4's nonresponse does cause A5's listening.

relationship.evidence: B2 questions failure and B4 reports silence, without establishing why B needs this expedition to succeed.

heightening.evidence: A5 changes the activity to listening, but adds little commitment beyond A3's knocking.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a map and wall, but no destination or practical reason to find the door.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'At doors' economically limits the admitted failure; A5 stays within the wall premise.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 turns the blocked route into waking the wall; A3 and A5 reveal replacement missions and immediately extinguish the torch and hold breath.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 reports no response and a dying torch, prompting A3's darkness mission; B4 hears only breathing, prompting A5's breath-control mission.

relationship.evidence: B2 supplies dwindling resources and B4 reports what is audible, but B expresses little personal purpose beyond accompanying A.

heightening.evidence: A3 sacrifices their light; A5 makes A's own breathing the next instrument of the mission after B4's observation.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes treasure hunters stopped at a solid wall; B2's torch gives the actors a concrete shared predicament.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's extinguishing the useful torch and A5's holding breath economically express sincere, increasingly counterproductive certainty.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2's failed knocking and fading torch become A3's claim that darkness was the intended mission.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 identifies breathing as the sole sound; A5 treats that exact result as evidence of a breath-control test.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 each reinterpret failure as a previously hidden goal and announce an immediate action.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The failed expedition progresses from knocking to surrendering light to holding breath, increasing personal commitment.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: Each failed operation reveals a supposedly concealed objective, which A immediately begins pursuing.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Optimistic reframing could celebrate failure without replacing the plan's intended goal.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A1 makes waking the wall the real mission, and A5 replaces that mission with listening through it.

records.recommendedEdit: The revision gives B practical pressure and makes both failures redirect immediate action. Internal reread scores fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 4, brevity 4: 90. B4 identifies breathing, causing A5 to declare and begin breath control.
records.remainingConcern: B remains chiefly an observer; a stronger individual stake could enrich the interaction. No rewrite needed for this internal pass.
records.writerReservation: The revised breath-control mission is a substantial irrational leap; sincerity must make it feel discovered rather than chosen for a joke.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike the radio operators in alternative b, these explorers lose practical resources through A's own actions, making the escalation more consequential.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The signal won't transmit. We were sent to receive, not send.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's only static.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the static's our message. Write the rhythm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's stopped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now we're learning silence. Keep recording.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Base can't hear our ship's report. We were secretly sent to receive. I'm switching channels.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only static. I need a forecast before my watch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's applause. Our real mission is entertaining base. I'm singing the forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now they've switched off. You've lost our audience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this was rejection training. I'm handing you the microphone; refuse me a second verse.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 recasts transmission as reception and A5 declares learning silence; A3 mostly salvages reception rather than changing goals.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's static becomes A3's rhythm transcription, and B4's stoppage becomes A5's recording of silence.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 supply equipment updates but reveal no personal duty, urgency or competing choice.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes the mission more abstract but 'Keep recording' barely changes the practical commitment.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a failed signal, but the sender, recipient and purpose remain unspecified.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Write the rhythm' and A5's 'Keep recording' express the logic without explanation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 converts failed reporting into receiving; A3 converts failed reception into entertainment; A5 converts audience loss into rejection training. Each new secret mission prompts immediate action.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's static as applause and forecast request as song material. A5 uses B4's lost audience to seek another rejection, though contact with base becomes slightly unclear.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs a forecast before taking watch, giving B a practical stake. B4 reports the audience loss, and A5 recruits this colleague into rejection training.

heightening.evidence: After B4 reports the audience gone, A5 turns failure into a mission requiring B personally to reject a second verse.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a ship reporting to base; B2 adds a watch and forecast. A5's microphone provides a playable next action.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'singing the forecast' combines both B2 details economically; A5's request for refusal earns its joke through the new rejection mission.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 supplies both static and the needed forecast; A3 reinterprets the former and sings the latter.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 explicitly identifies audience loss, which A5 treats as evidence of a rejection-training mission.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 each reveal a different supposedly hidden goal after failure and immediately undertake it.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 moves from reinterpreting radio failures to actively soliciting rejection from B. The request remains fictional dialogue and leaves B's response open.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A treats each failure as evidence of a different secret assignment and immediately performs that assignment.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Persistence would keep trying to deliver the original report through another method.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A1 abandons sending, and A5 claims that learning silence was the purpose instead.

records.recommendedEdit: Preserved the original firstPass and replaced the rejected troubleshooting sequence within the shipboard setting. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, logic 4, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 5, brevity 4: 88. A1, A3 and A5 announce distinct hidden goals and immediate actions. B2's static becomes A3's supposed applause, while the requested forecast supplies the song. B4's lost audience defeats entertainment and causes A5's rejection exercise. B2 has watch duties; A5 draws that colleague into a more personal task. The microphone and second verse keep the concise final demand attached to the failed performance.
records.remainingConcern: The radio continuity is slightly loose: B2 hears only static, but B4 knows base has switched off. No rewrite is needed for an internal pass.
records.writerReservation: A3's interpretation of static as applause is a substantial inference, and B4's account of base switching off is accepted as scene information. A must sincerely discover the assignments rather than knowingly invent excuses.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved alternative pursues bodily experiments after a treasure-map failure. This version uses a colleague's operational need and ultimately recruits that colleague into its newly discovered mission.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Measure the cloud from its third elbow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Clouds don't have elbows.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not the first two. That's elementary cloud anatomy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Where's the third?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Where your ruler becomes damp. There, you've found it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we sell this bottled cloud, measure from its third elbow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the new assistant. I can only find two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The third appears when addressed by its professional title. Say 'Professor.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Professor. It's raining inside the bottle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Those are its credentials. Count the drops; that gives us its sleeve size.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 invents elementary cloud anatomy to answer B2; A5 invents dampness as the locating rule only after B4 asks where.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's objection triggers A3's anatomical exception; B4's location question triggers A5's ruler test.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 make B a pupil asking the required questions, with no independent reason to measure.

heightening.evidence: A5 provides a new rule but announces success without a new consequence or increased demand.

specificity.evidence: A1's cloud measurement lacks an accessible setting; A5 assumes a ruler can become damp against the cloud.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'elementary cloud anatomy' efficiently performs authority; A5 keeps the joke tied to measurement.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 confidently invents professional address when B2 cannot find the elbow; A5 declares unexpected rain to be credentials.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's missing elbow causes A3's title rule; B4's rain supplies A5's drop-counting rule, though sleeve size drifts from the original measurement.

relationship.evidence: B2 explicitly identifies as the new assistant, giving A3's authoritative instruction a credible teacher-and-novice relationship.

heightening.evidence: B4's apparent complication becomes A5's credential system and a further measuring procedure, extending A's claimed expertise.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes selling a bottled cloud; B2 clarifies the work relationship, although the purpose of measuring its elbow remains obscure.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Naturally' and A5's 'Excellent' efficiently sustain mastery while 'credentials' converts rain into an earned absurd explanation.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 cannot locate the third elbow, so A3 invents the title needed to reveal it.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 produces rain after saying 'Professor'; A5 interprets those drops as credentials and measuring data.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A's unbroken authority masks rules invented specifically to accommodate B's discoveries.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The missing anatomical feature expands into academic credentials and another impossible measurement, all within the sales procedure.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A projects complete expertise while supplying a fresh nonsensical rule precisely when a practical question requires one.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Random surreal description can name strange things without maintaining an expert's responsive authority.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A3 answers the elbow objection with anatomy, and A5 answers the location question with a dampness test.

records.recommendedEdit: A bottled-cloud shop is a new illustrative setting that makes measurement playable and gives B a role. Internal reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 4, brevity 4: 90. B4's rain creates A5's credential and sizing rules.
records.remainingConcern: The switch to sleeve size slightly loosens the original measuring task. No rewrite needed for this internal pass.
records.writerReservation: The final sleeve-size rule is deliberately strange; its connection to the established elbows needs confident, practical delivery.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative a uses expert training and cooperative discovery; b uses urgent domestic troubleshooting and a threatened deposit.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Turn the gravity dial politely, not clockwise.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Pause at every number as though it might object.

beats.speaker: B

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 defines polite turning after B2 asks how; A5 interprets the newly reported click as acceptance.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 supplies B2's missing procedure, and A5 specifically interprets B4's click at six.

relationship.evidence: B2 requests instruction and B4 reports a result, but B has no visible purpose beyond assisting A's demonstration.

heightening.evidence: A5 confirms success without expanding the rule's demand or consequence.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a playable dial but does not establish what the gravity adjustment is meant to accomplish.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's pauses and A5's accepting six maintain one compact logic of etiquette.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's question directly generates A3's pauses; B4's clicked six and rising armchairs become A5's host and witnesses.

relationship.evidence: B2 fears losing a deposit and follows A's expertise; B4's worsening result forces A to provide another remedy.

heightening.evidence: B4 expands the problem from one sofa to armchairs; A5 expands private dial etiquette into a public obligation to the entire suite.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a ceiling-bound sofa and gravity dial; B2 adds the deposit stake, making the impossible repair readily playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's numbers disliking being passed over leads economically to A5's assembled furniture requiring a public apology.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 requests a usable definition of polite turning; A3 supplies pauses at each number.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 reports six activating additional furniture; A5 names six as the inviter and prescribes an apology to the resulting assembly.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A never admits uncertainty and introduces each new rule only when B's difficulty requires it.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The repair becomes a larger social breach involving the whole furniture suite, increasing the scope of A's invented expertise.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A supplies authoritative rules of strange etiquette as each new operational problem makes them necessary.

mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A3 invents the turning procedure in response to B2, and A5 gives B4's click an expert interpretation.

records.recommendedEdit: The revision adds a concrete repair objective and replaces mere confirmation with a consequential new rule. Internal reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 5, brevity 4: 92. B4's rising chairs require A5's public apology.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A flying chair needs a flying table. Where else will it eat?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One flying chair is enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Enough for sitting. We're discussing hospitality.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then a flying table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And a hovering waiter. We can't keep making it land for soup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For my restaurant, your flying chair needs a flying table. Dinner should travel with the diner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can make the whole table circle the room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add a hovering waiter. Nobody should chase their soup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter can serve while flying upside down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then commission gravity-proof soup. I won't make customers rotate between courses.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 extends a flying chair into a table and A5 adds a hovering waiter, each justified through hospitality.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2's sufficiency objection; B4's acceptance of the table enables A5's service requirement.

relationship.evidence: B2 tries to limit the project and B4 concedes, but B's resources or purpose remain unclear.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands the accepted flying table into a staffed airborne meal.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes flying furniture but not whether these speakers are buying, building or arranging it.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's hospitality distinction earns A5's practical concern about landing for soup.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 answers B2's circling table with a hovering waiter; A5 answers B4's inverted service with gravity-proof soup, each justified by diner convenience.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 makes the meal mobile, causing A3's mobile service; B4 introduces inversion, causing A5's gravity-proof food.

relationship.evidence: A1 is a restaurant customer for B's invention; B2 and B4 offer capabilities that A converts into larger commissions.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves beyond flying furniture and staff to redesigning the food's physics because B4 offers upside-down service.

specificity.evidence: A1 names the restaurant and the need to keep dinner with its diner; A3 and A5 retain soup as the practical service problem.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Nobody should chase their soup' and A5's refusal to rotate customers make the absurd additions concise expressions of hospitality.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2's circling table requires a waiter who can keep pace, prompting A3's hovering staff.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4's upside-down waiter introduces gravity as the service problem; A5 commissions soup immune to it.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Every offered capability provokes a more ambitious purchase supported by A's consistent concern for customers.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The restaurant commission escalates from airborne equipment to airborne service to impossible food.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A answers each impossible proposal by committing to a still more impossible provision with a practical justification.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Generic escalation can add extravagant objects without answering B's particular strange offer.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A5 adds a hovering waiter because B4 has accepted the flying table, preserving the hospitality rationale.

records.recommendedEdit: The revision establishes a restaurant purchase and gives B two genuine strange offers to heighten. Internal reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 5, specificity 4, brevity 4: 93. B4's inverted service directly requires A5's soup invention.
records.remainingConcern: B is an accommodating supplier with little resistance, but the offers materially develop the commission. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: The restaurant is a new illustrative setting. Gravity-proof soup is clear comic logic, but the actor must prioritize customer comfort over celebrating the invention.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative a uses practical service specifications; b uses wedding inclusion and expands into time travel, with less secure justifications.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our invisible guest will need places for the entourage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We only invited one guest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't expect them to leave invisible companions outside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many places?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Set the room. We'll count the untouched plates afterward.

beats.text: Your invisible guest is welcome at our wedding. I'll reserve places for invisible companions.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: I'll rent a ballroom that follows them. Nobody should miss cake.

beats.speaker: B

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 enlarges the invisible guest premise, but B2's headcount objection and B4's question offer no further strange capability.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2 by positing companions; A5 answers B4's quantity question by reserving the room.

relationship.evidence: B2 protects the invitation count and B4 seeks workable seating instructions.

heightening.evidence: A5 commits the entire room to the possible entourage introduced in A1.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a guest and places but leaves the hosts' event and authority vague.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 is compact, but untouched plates cannot clearly establish how many invisible diners attended.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 answers B2's wall-walking guests with a following ballroom, justified by cake access; A5 answers B4's splitting ballroom with multiplying cake and equal hospitality.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's wandering family directly requires A3's mobile venue; B4's separate rooms directly require A5's distributed cake.

relationship.evidence: B2 supplies a family accommodation problem, but B4 mainly supplies another magical capability. B's position as guest representative or venue provider remains indistinct.

heightening.evidence: A3 commits to renting an impossible ballroom; B4 makes it divide, and A5 extends the impossible provision to every room's first slice.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes wedding hospitality and reserved places; A3 and A5 give actors clear accommodation choices, although B4's 'our ballroom' blurs B's role.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Nobody should miss cake' and A5's 'Every room deserves the first slice' give concise, sincere reasons for the escalating impossibilities.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 makes the invisible family wander through walls; A3 provides a ballroom that follows them so they receive cake.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers rooms that split with the guests; A5 orders cake that multiplies along with those rooms.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A3 and A5 accept strange capabilities and commission more ambitious impossibilities with explicit hospitality justifications.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 expands accommodating mobile guests into providing simultaneous first slices across multiplying rooms.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A commits to a greater impossibility in direct response to each strange offer, explaining its value to the occasion.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Inventing unseen extra guests alone could be assumption-making without reciprocal escalation.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A3 justifies invisible companions through hospitality, but the lack of a new strange offer from B4 weakens the exact mechanism.

records.recommendedEdit: Replaced the rejected invisible-wall and future-song justifications while preserving the wedding, invisible guest and companions. Internal reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 4, brevity 4: 90. A1 establishes wedding accommodation; B2's wall-crossing wanderers cause A3's following ballroom; B4's helpful room-splitting capability requires A5's multiplying cake. B contributes family knowledge and a venue capability; A5 increases the catering commitment for a specific reason.
